comment.es: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Varios</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani ha retirado su apoyo a la propuesta de Resolución común RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.cs: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Různé</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani stáhl svou podporu společného návrhu usnesení RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.bg: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Разни</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Малик Азмани оттегли подкрепата си за общото предложение за резолюция RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pt: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Diversos</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani retirou o seu apoio à proposta de resolução comum RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.en: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Miscellaneous</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani had withdrawn his support from joint motion for a resolution RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.it: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Varie</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani ha ritirato il proprio sostegno alla proposta di risoluzione comune RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pl: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Różne</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani wycofał swoje poparcie dla wspólnego projektu rezolucji RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fr: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Divers</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani a retiré son soutien à la proposition de résolution commune RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.mt: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Varji</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani irtira l-appoġġ tiegħu għall-mozzjoni għal riżoluzzjoni konġunta RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ro: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani și-a retras susținerea pentru propunerea comună de rezoluție RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.el: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Διάφορα</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Ο Malik Azmani αποσύρει την υποστήριξή του από την κοινή πρόταση ψηφίσματος RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sl: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani je umaknil podporo skupnemu predlogu resolucije RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ga: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Aon ghnó eile</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani a retiré son soutien à la proposition de résolution commune RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.nl: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Diversen</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani trekt zijn steun voor gezamenlijke ontwerpresolutie RC-B10-0102/2025 in.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sk: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Iné</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani stiahol svoju podporu spoločnému návrhu uznesenia RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sv: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Övriga frågor</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani hade dragit tillbaka sitt stöd för det gemensamma resolutionsförslaget RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.et: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Muud küsimused</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani võttis toetuse resolutsiooni ühisettepanekule RC-B10-0102/2025 tagasi.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lt: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Įvairūs</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani atšaukė savo paramą bendram pasiūlymui dėl rezoliucijos RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.de: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Verschiedenes</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani hat seine Unterstützung für den gemeinsamen Entschließungsantrag RC-B10-0102/2025 zurückgezogen.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lv: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Dažādi</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani atsauca savu atbalstu no kopīgā rezolūcijas priekšlikuma RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.hu: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Egyéb</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani visszavonta támogatását az RC-B10-0102/2025 sz. közös állásfoglalási indítványról.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.hr: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani povukao je svoju podršku zajedničkom prijedlogu rezolucije RC-B10-0102/2025.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.da: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Malik Azmani trak sin støtte til det fælles beslutningsforslag RC-B10-0102/2025 tilbage </translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
